map.比较两组数据的离散程度是否相近。: Checks whether two data sets have similar dispersion.
map.📖 查看「变异系数比较使用指南」: 📖 View the "Comparing Coefficients of Variation User Guide"
map.变异系数 CV 用标准差除以均值绝对值，消除量纲后比较两组数据的相对离散程度。C: The coefficient of variation CV divides the standard deviation by the absolute mean, removing units so the relative dispersion of two groups can be compared. A larger CV means relatively stronger fluctuation; when the units or magnitudes differ, CV is more appropriate than comparing standard deviations directly.
map.CV 消除了量纲影响，可比较不同单位的数据。: CV removes the effect of units, so data measured on different scales can be compared.
map.比较两组数据的相对离散度（CV=σ/|μ|）。: Compares the relative dispersion of two data sets (CV=σ/|μ|).
map.均值差异大时判断哪组更\"不稳\"。: Judges which group is less stable when the means differ sharply.
map.CV 大者相对波动更大。: The larger CV fluctuates more in relative terms.
map.组1 μ=100、σ=10 → CV=10%；组2 μ=50、σ=8 → CV=: Group 1 with μ=100, σ=10 gives CV=10%; group 2 with μ=50, σ=8 gives CV=16%, so group 2 fluctuates more relatively despite the smaller σ.
map.A 年化 10%、σ 12%（CV120%）；B 年化 5%、σ 6%（CV12: A returns 10% a year with σ 12% (CV 120%); B returns 5% with σ 6% (CV 120%). The CVs match, so the risk-return trade-off is the same.
map.防均值负时 CV 误号；通常用绝对值衡量相对波动大小。: It prevents CV from taking the wrong sign when the mean is negative; the absolute value measures relative volatility.
map.标准差是绝对离散，CV 是相对离散，跨量纲/跨均值比较必须用 CV。: The standard deviation measures absolute dispersion and CV relative dispersion, so comparisons across units or across very different means must use CV.
